item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical Battle Harness provides a reliable load-bearing solution to keep your belt secure and comfortable. Designed with 4 webbing straps, it seamlessly attaches to D-rings on your battle belt. Padded shoulder straps and a yoke ensure all-day comfort, while the breathable double-layer mesh back panel helps prevent sweat buildup. 6 rows of MOLLE webbing, elastic loops, and D-rings on the shoulder straps allow for custom attachments and gear organization.
description: Rothco’s Tactical Battle Harness provides a reliable load-bearing solution to keep your belt secure and comfortable. Designed with 4 webbing straps, it seamlessly attaches to D-rings on your battle belt. Padded shoulder straps and a yoke ensure all-day comfort, while the breathable double-layer mesh back panel helps prevent sweat buildup. 6 rows of MOLLE webbing, elastic loops, and D-rings on the shoulder straps allow for custom attachments and gear organization. The back panel features an 8.5 inches x 4 inches loop field for patches or additional accessories and includes a drag handle for emergency situations. Compatible with Rothco’s Tactical Battle Belt, this harness is ideal for tactical and outdoor applications.
